body_type.description: Optional visual proportions v1: 1 straight, 2 broader upper body, 3 fuller hips, 4 defined waist, 5 fuller middle, 6 fuller balanced proportions. Context only; not scored or converted to measurements.

height_cm.description: Optional height in cm for length-bearing charts. Does not infer body lengths.

measurements.description: Optional body measurements in cm, restricted to fields advertised by the questionnaire. Never send garment dimensions.

silhouette_hips.description: Fashion sizing assets v1: asset stem and option number. Optional context only; no measurement or confidence derived from starter priors.

silhouette_shoulders.description: Fashion sizing assets v1: asset stem and option number. Optional context only; no measurement or confidence derived from starter priors.

silhouette_thigh.description: Fashion sizing assets v1: asset stem and option number. Optional context only; no measurement or confidence derived from starter priors.

silhouette_waist.description: Fashion sizing assets v1: asset stem and option number. Optional context only; no measurement or confidence derived from starter priors.

weight_kg.description: Optional adult weight in kg for apparel. Context only: not used in size scoring or confidence.

rows.description: Ordered smallest to largest. Every row must contain every declared measurement. Labels map exactly to variant sizes.

verified.description: Merchant confirmation that measurements, units, basis and methods were reviewed. Required true for recommendations.

rows.description: Ordered smallest to largest. Every row must contain every declared measurement. Labels map exactly to variant sizes.

verified.description: Merchant confirmation that measurements, units, basis and methods were reviewed. Required true for recommendations.

session_token.description: Website-server-only session token. Store in an HttpOnly cookie, never browser JSON.

product_ids.description: Products in the same store and category as the chart. All selected links update atomically; other product fields and unselected links are preserved.

password.description: At least 12 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

query.description: Original Shopify-signed app-launch query without a leading question mark. Never log it or accept an unsigned shop override.

launch_query.description: Original Shopify-signed app-launch query without a leading question mark. Never log it or accept an unsigned shop override.

password.description: At least 12 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.

confidence.description: Uncalibrated evidence score, never a probability or accuracy claim.

APIKey.description: Merchant admin or store-scoped secret API key. Returned once at creation.

BootstrapKey.description: Operator-only BOOTSTRAP_KEY, used only to create merchants.

ConsoleGateway.description: Website server secret; enables console access.
ConsoleGateway.name: X-Metr-Console-Key

ConsoleSession.description: Short-lived seller session, valid only on console routes.

info.description: Standalone multi-tenant sizing API. Server-to-server Bearer keys only: never embed secret keys in browser or Shopify theme code. All measurements submitted by customers are body measurements in cm. Confidence is an uncalibrated evidence score, not a fit probability. Requests are limited to 256 KiB. Merchant/store-scoped resource IDs are opaque.
